result:
Looking at the qlang documentation and the provided data, I'll write a query for each task. Let me work through them systematically, understanding the pipeline model and verbs described.

R1: Filter for active users in Berlin (case-insensitive), extract and sort names.

R2: Filter numeric ages, compute and round average.

R3: Filter paid orders, compute qty*price totals per customer with groupBy.

R4: Filter open issues, group by assignee (null → "unassigned"), count.

R5: Filter open issues, sort by comments descending then number ascending, take top 3, extract numbers.

R6: Extract entries from both dependency maps, filter for "^" version prefix, deduplicate.

R7: Parse log lines, filter status ≥500, extract distinct paths.

R8: Parse log lines, filter GET requests, extract duration (remove "ms"), compute average.

R9: Parse CSV, skip empty salaries, group by dept, compute average salary per dept.

R10: Parse CSV, extract skills, split by ";", lowercase, flatten and deduplicate.

R11: Parse KEY=VALUE lines, filter for DB_* keys (case-sensitive), remove prefix and lowercase.

R12: Filter enabled services, construct URL with default port 80, sort by name.

R13: Sum purchase amounts, count distinct users, check for any refund (case-insensitive).

R14: Lowercase strings, group by value, filter for count>1, extract keys.

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(/address | ne null) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(/age | type | eq :number) | * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy /customer | * (* /items | flat | * (~(mul /qty /price)) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(/assignee | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") | * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number
R6: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/value | startsWith "^") | * /key | distinct
R7: lines | * (split " " | {:path /2 :status /3}) | filter ~(/status | parseJson | gte 500) | * /path | distinct
R8: lines | * (split " " | {:method /1 :duration /4}) | filter ~(/method | eq "GET") | * (/duration | split "m" | first | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:dept /1 :salary /2}) | filter ~(/salary | ne "") | groupBy /dept | * (* /salary | * parseJson | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | /3 | split ";" | * (/trim | lower)) | flat | distinct
R11: lines | filter ~(/trim | ne "") | filter ~(/trim | startsWith "#" | not) | * (split "=" | {:key (/0 | trim) :value (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)}) | filter ~(/key | startsWith "DB_") | * ({:key (/key | drop 3 | lower) :value /value}) | groupBy /key | * (* /value | first)
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/value | /enabled | coalesce false) | * (:svc /value | {:name /key :url (/svc | /protocol | append "://" | append (/svc | /host) | append ":" | append ((/svc | /port | coalesce 80) | json))}) | sort ~(/name)
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | * (/meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") | * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (* (/type | lower) | any ~(eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | * lower | groupBy / | filter ~(. | count | gt 1) | keys | sort
